title: Pay at the Fern; Buzzy Willow takes over the band
summary: Sal explains $40 a week pay at the Fern and how Buzzy Willow became leader.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: I didn't get into the job. I said, Goppsen, oh, he's a great drummer. Which he is. But the guy said, he got a break with B-Funk. I mean, the guy's a top-knop musician, man. He can play with anybody. How much did they pay at the fern? I'm always wondering. Well, I'll tell you that story, too. I'll give it to you straight. A nickel? A nickel? No, man. They didn't Father Goppsen, because poor man's dead, man. This Father Billy Gillen. He played just like Bakesh Pounder back then. He played trumpet. He was in the band, see? And he went for Hunt, see? He ain't got a contraria. He got back late and all that stuff. So Buzzy, I'm sure I said that, but I'd like to say Buzzy stole the deal on him, see? Buzzy got told to Harry, and they made Buzzy the leader, see? Well, he was in the band, but they made Buzzy the band leader. Which Buzzy? Buzzy Willow. Yeah.

Buzzy Willow. The band-jole player. Yeah, the band-jole player. Well, the job was ready to play, paid forty dollars a week, see? Which was bad in those days. Forty weeks, see? But each leader, when they cut everybody down, see? If the guy was very good, you know, I'd pay him a little more, such as Harry Shields, you know, I'd give Harry a little more, cut the drummer down a little more, see? And so on, you know, that's how it worked, you see? My mom gave it to you straight. So when Bill was there, I got forty dollars a week. I'll be in Harry, I got forty-five. I made forty, I made forty. And then when Buzzy got told, when it came in now, it's thirty years, I said, nah. I went to Harry, man, Harry, who else, you know? She said, you know, she's been slow, you know. I ain't slow for Harry, is it? I mean, she was, you know. I paid him, but he made my money, man. I want that money. And that was the day I was young, my mama, I had my mama, good clothes, and I had different set every night, man. Shields, man, I was dressed in macula, man. Poor Harry Shields, but two pairs, different colors, man. Three white, five women, man, paying everybody, couldn't afford nothing, you know.
